messages.author: 5a998280e3422cde
messages.subject: Re: cannot deploy my shinyapp to shinyapp.io ,Error: 404 not found
parts: In your App folder or working directory, there is a folder called rsconnect, you need to delete that folder and redeploy your app. This is because shiny is caching the info from prior deployment in that folder.
